top_signals.title: Marcos Needs State of the Nation to Revive Philippine Economy, Presidency
top_signals.summary: A year ago, Philippines President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s annual address to Congress shocked the nation with revelations of billions of dollars of graft involving flood-control schemes. The disclosure triggered an economic slump as projects slowed and consumers and businesses cut spending.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
